t: DISTRIBUTION OF CHILD PASSENGER SAFETY SEAT SYSTEMS

l: In this chapter, "child passenger safety seat system" has the meaning assigned by Section 545.412, Transportation Code.

items.t: CHILD PASSENGER SAFETY SEAT SYSTEM PROGRAM
l: (a) The department may establish a program to distribute child passenger safety seat systems to indigent persons in this state.
(b) A program established under this section may distribute new or used child passenger safety seat systems that have been donated to the department for distribution.
The executive commissioner may adopt rules governing eligibility for a child passenger safety seat system from the program established under Section 45.002.
